title: Allow capping retry backoff delays
body: `backoff_delays` in `netutil/backoff.py` doubles the delay on every attempt with no upper bound, so long retry loops end up waiting for minutes. Please add an optional keyword argument `max_delay` (default `None`, meaning no limit) that clamps every delay to at most `max_delay`. A `max_delay` that is zero or negative is a programming error and should raise `ValueError`. Existing callers must keep working unchanged.
